title: Livestreaming US execution would breach prohibition of torture, UN rights office warns
content: The UN human rights office (OHCHR) on Friday warned that livestreaming a planned execution by firing squad in the United States would amount to a public execution and breach the absolute prohibition on torture.

title: Afghanistan: Women face fresh dress code arrests amid record refugee returns
content: Afghan women and girls are being arrested, detained and threatened with arrest by Taliban authorities, the UN warned on Thursday as record numbers of returnees struggle to rebuild their lives back home.

title: ICC unseals four arrest warrants over Taliban persecution of women and girls
content: The International Criminal Court (ICC) has made public four arrest warrants against senior Taliban figures, accusing them of persecuting women and girls in Afghanistan, which amounts to a crime against humanity.
